summary: Backend regression tests after pinning pymongo==4.6.3 / motor==3.3.1. All 18 tests passed. MongoDB write (POST /api/orders) and read (GET /api/orders/track) work correctly with the pinned driver, confirming the Render deploy fix did not break DB flows.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handler (non-blocking).
server.py: OrderCreate.address is dict (unvalidated) — consider Pydantic model for phone/email/pincode validation.
server.py: uses payload.items[i].dict() (Pydantic v1 API) — should be .model_dump() for Pydantic v2 forward-compat (works today via compat shim).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ order created via POST /api/orders (phone 9876543210) — used for track flow verification. Left in DB (no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_regression.py covers root, products (list/filter/detail), search, coupons (DAPPER10/STREET20/FLAT300), orders create+track (Mongo r/w), and confirms /api/auth/me is 404. Run with: pytest backend/tests/test_backend_regression.py -v
rca of the issue: No issue found. pymongo==4.6.3 + motor==3.3.1 pin works correctly with Python 3.11.15 runtime — order insert_one and find_one both operational.
